title: UNOSAT Rapid Mapping Archive
description: Mirror of the satellite-derived flood extents, damage assessments, and camp mapping that the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNITAR-UNOSAT) publishes on [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/unosat). Each collection is one UNOSAT event; the `combined` collections join damage sites and water extents across events. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) before you query.
